What You’ll Do Design, build, and evolve a production-grade .NET 10 modular monolith (ASP.NET Core Minimal APIs, CQRS with command/query handlers, module boundaries, shared kernel) powering payments, digital banking, and crypto flows for multiple tenants. Build event-driven flows with Wolverine and RabbitMQ: integration events, durable messaging, idempotent handlers, retries and dead-letter recovery. Develop and harden integrations with banking, payments, KYC, and crypto providers : REST APIs, OAuth, HMAC-signed webhooks, polling and reconciliation backstops that keep the ledger and the bank in sync. Work with EF Core 10 on SQL Server : schema design and migrations, efficient projections, indexing and query tuning, strict no-N+1 discipline on money-critical paths. Contribute to our Angular 19 front-ends (back-office and customer portals): services, interceptors, guards, RxJS/Signals, i18n. Own your modules end-to-end: development, xUnit testing, deployment via GitHub Actions to Azure , and production monitoring (Serilog, OpenTelemetry, Log Analytics). Operate production: diagnose incidents across application logs, database, and provider logs; reconcile money movements down to the last cent. Collaborate closely with architects, DevOps, product, and compliance (AML/sanction screening, transaction monitoring, risk rules, 2FA/SCA). Make and document technical decisions with incomplete information, balancing risk, quality, and delivery. Tech Must-Haves You should be hands-on and battle-tested with: 8+ years of professional .NET / C# , including correct async/await usage and CancellationToken discipline, solid understanding of memory, threading, and performance, and the ability to profile and diagnose production issues. ASP.NET Core (Minimal APIs preferred): dependency injection, middleware, authentication/authorization, API versioning. EF Core and SQL Server / T-SQL : migrations, query design, performance tuning, and indexing on high-volume transactional data. Architecture : modular monolith or well-structured service architectures, CQRS, domain events, clean module boundaries, backward-compatible change. Messaging : RabbitMQ (or similar) with Wolverine, MassTransit, or NServiceBus — event-driven design, idempotency, outbox/durable delivery, dead-letter handling. Real Azure experience : App Services, Azure SQL, Key Vault, Application Gateway/WAF, Log Analytics/Application Insights; CI/CD with GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps. External integrations and APIs , including third-party and fintech service providers: webhooks with signature verification, OAuth flows, resilience patterns (Polly), reconciliation. Angular

jobs.details: Technical Project Manager Technical Project Manager Cheil Adriatic d.o.o. Beograd | Hibrid online intervju 06.10.2026. intermediate About the Role: We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Technical Project Manager to support the delivery of multiple projects and client accounts. You will work closely with senior project managers, cross-functional teams, and external stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget. Key Responsibilities: Manages a large multiple project/client account or multiple projects simultaneously. Works in a team of project managers, escalates and prioritizes workflows in order to secure service delivery on time. Coordinates resources through all elements of the team. Estimates time, risk, and resources of the project request, and guarantees delivery of the project scope on time and within budget. Tracks and controls asset delivery from the client or third-party vendor. Administers and monitors project cost. Holds regular meetings with members of the internal and external team to ensure progress, next steps and possible blockers on the project, and sends feedback to relevant stakeholders. Troubleshoots problems with members of the internal and external team and takes part in the maintenance of the current project. Analyzes changes to the initial project request and assesses if the change is valid. Proactively plans and identifies possible blockers and issues, notifies all parties, and escalates to relevant stakeholders. Identifies possible improvements for existing processes and procedures. Works closely with his team and manager. Takes care of team cohesion, their efficiency and wellbeing. Takes part with Cheil’s central team and/or upper management in defining project scope and goals for project members. Demonstrates proper work method and procedures to junior colleagues. Requirements: 2+ year of experience in project coordination or a similar role (preferred). Basic understanding of project management principles and tools. Strong organizational and time management skills. Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal). Ability to work in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment. Problem-solving mindset and attention to detail. Experience working with technical or digital projects. Familiarity with project management tools. Basic technical understanding (web, software, or digital production processes). We offer: An attractive professional environment Competitive terms and conditions Private health insurance Modern, sunny, and open working place with a positive and fun atmosphere We are looking forward to meeting you!
